scope: One fresh Kind v1.36.1 cluster in the runner's saf-test namespace; official MLflow 3.5.1 server and client image, one SQLite backend, and a same-Pod authenticated append-only audit bridge. The server binds only to Pod loopback; the only Service targets the bridge. A fixed five-request sequence exercises experiment creation, experiment read, run creation, parameter write, and run deletion through actual MLflow REST APIs with three fixture-only Basic-auth symbolic actors. The sequence runs once with audit off and once with audit on; a separate permitted read checks continued access. Dynamic experiment/run IDs are retained only in raw evidence. This is not proof of production identity federation, every MLflow endpoint, artifact store access, durable/tamper-resistant export, retention, or Kubernetes network policy.

checks.claim: With the audit bridge disabled, fixed MLflow API operations succeed but leave no persisted actor-aware events
With audit enabled, the same successful MLflow dispatch persists actor, operation, resource ID, and result
An approved reader continues to retrieve the fixed experiment while an attributable read event is persisted
